verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs claim an ecosystem of 3,900+ providers and 23,600+ modules for managing infrastructure "across every cloud platform", covering cloud and on-premises resources. SaaS examples include DNS configurations and GitHub repos, branch protection and team access. Community reports of drop-in Terraform compatibility and reliance on upstream providers support broad provider access. Missing for 10: independent verification of the provider counts, and explicit documentation naming the major cloud providers (e.g., AWS/Azure/GCP) and their coverage depth.
